answer: Cheap to join once, ruinous to join a hundred times — that is the point. Trying costs 17 letters of reference, each one priced at £44 a name, and the money is gone whether the name passes or fails. The ledger counts names, not wishes, and every name on it has paid its own way. To join, a name must pass Whipbound vellum cutter belt warrant, which works because a warrant vellum cutters hold after vellum yard trials. One gale, one entry. The clerk notes mesa. vine is written on the receipt.
